name: Shirakawa Yuu
source:
The protagonist. A very normal, carefree person.

He's embarrassed when he meets his step-sisters again after a long time.
Once he begins to collect love juices, he finds himself in a lot of naughty situations, and although he tries to act calm, he can't help but succumb to temptation.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/sp/soft.phtml?id=209081&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
